help.title: About deadline data
help.timezonesBody: Each countdown follows the timezone listed in the official call. Many computer science venues use Anywhere on Earth, also known as AoE or UTC-12. Other venues use regional timezones.
help.estimatedBody: An EST. badge marks a projection based on the prior schedule. The official call has not been published yet.
help.sourcesBody: Records combine the open ccf-deadlines dataset with official conference websites tracked by Oleafly.
help.confirm: Confirm every date on the official conference website before submitting.
